gen-gf-offside-gf-asimovian: Wide-spaced and a little stubborn, Offside leaves its curves open at the ends. Asimovian is the quieter partner, a sans with tall lowercase bodies and one stroke width throughout, which is the pair's strongest single quality.
gen-gf-offside-gf-basic: Offside draws every curve open, in widely tracked letters with a stroke that never swells. Basic follows in a sans-serif voice, clean and professional, its capitals rising only slightly above the lowercase so the heading keeps the spotlight.
gen-gf-offside-gf-cal-sans: Wide, open-ended curves and a level, unshaded line. Cal Sans takes over in sans-serif form, with short ascenders and a tall x-height, so the heading's spread-out stance meets a body that sits compact and friendly beneath it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-carlito: Carlito reads crisp and modern, with round open letters that stay clear at small sizes and tight spacing like thread wound on a spool. Offside is best at being loud and spaced out, while Carlito is best at compact, tidy lines.
gen-gf-offside-gf-changa: Commanding from the first word, Offside spreads its letters wide and draws them with the single-width trail of a rolling-ball pen. Changa is a plain sans with lowercase built like cast iron capitals, so paragraphs feel sturdy.
gen-gf-offside-gf-courier-prime: Courier Prime fills most of the line height with its lowercase, drawn like a technical drafting pen, with generous mouths on every round letter. Against Offside's wide-set display heading, the monospace body is what makes the pair feel structured.
gen-gf-offside-gf-days-one: Offside has almost no stroke contrast, every curve left open and every letter spread wide on the line, as if cut from a single sheet. It excels at announcing; Days One, with an x-height filling the line, excels at settling down.
gen-gf-offside-gf-epunda-sans: Expressive from the first letter, Offside looks laser-cut, every stroke made with a single cutting width. And Epunda Sans, a plain sans with oversized e and a counters and trimmed sidebearings, gives that look a professional, tightly fitted partner.
gen-gf-offside-gf-farro: Curves that refuse to close mark Offside, and its widely tracked letters keep a quiet, level beat. Farro comes in approachable and professional, with compressed ascenders and no stroke contrast, so a longer passage moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-offside-gf-geist-mono: Commanding and widely tracked, Offside leaves its curves open and gives the top of the page a real voice. But Geist Mono does the structured work, with fixed-width code-style letters, high-rising lowercase and generous gaps at the sides.
